src: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.” A Warning to Coniah
tgt: Inwe abanto ba Lebanoni, mwabeire more n’obotoereru ase ebiswa biaino ime, ase egati y’emecharake. Ekeene, namweumie ekero moraigwe obororo, obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore. Ekiina kia Nyasae igoro ya Konia

src: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
tgt: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.

src: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
tgt: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.

src: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

src: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

src: And the people implored the Lord Most High, in prayer before him who is merciful, until the worship of the Lord was finished, and so they accomplished his service.
tgt: Erio abanto bakamogaramera Omonene kegima, bakamosaba ere omonyene amaabera goika omoroberio bw'okomosasiima Omonene okaera. Naboigo banyaarete gokora okomosasiima ere.

src: Nao watu wakamwomba Bwana Aliye Juu Zaidi, wakimwomba Yeye aliye na huruma, hata ibada ya Bwana ikamilike, nao wakakamilisha huduma yake.

src: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
tgt: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng'a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

src: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
tgt: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng'a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

src: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
tgt: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo aye gwateebire, korende nabateebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto oikaransete ensemo y'okoboko gw'okorio kw'Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”

src: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
tgt: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.

src: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
tgt: Omonto oria orasaambe ebinto ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; magega y'ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.

src: who tell the seers, “Don't see!” and the prophets, “Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
tgt: Nigo bagoteebia abarori b'amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang'ana,” na bateebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobaanera amang'ana amaronge; toteebie amang'ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobaanere ay'obong'ainereria.

src: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
tgt: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abaanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.

src: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
tgt: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,

src: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
tgt: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.

src: He built the upper gate of Yahweh's house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.
tgt: Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki'enyomba y'Omonene, naende agakora emeremo emenene ase okoagacha orwaki rw'Ofeli.

src: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
tgt: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

src: But as for ourselves, many afflictions and many wars have encompassed us, and the kings who are around us have fought against us.
tgt: Korende intwe twabeire togotwara obokong'u ne emechando boigo chiseegi kera engaki, ase engencho ebisaku bitoetanaine biabeire bigotorwania.

src: Lakini sisi wenyewe, mateso mengi na vita vingi vimetuzunguka, na wafalme walio karibu nasi wamepigana nasi.
tgt: Korende intwe twabeire togotwara obokong'u ne emechando boigo chiseegi kera engaki, ase engencho ebisaku bitoetanaine biabeire bigotorwania.

src: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
tgt: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.

src: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
tgt: Mwarooche ebinto babwate bi'okogeechia, emegwekano yabo baare gosasiima, yaroisirie korwa ase emete, n'amagena, ne'chifeta, ne'chitaabu, eyio yarenge ase egati yabo.

src: Then Samson said: “With the jawbone of a donkey I have piled them into heaps. With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men.”
tgt: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

src: Ndipo Samsoni akasema, “Kwa taya la punda malundo juu ya malundo. Kwa taya la punda nimeua watu 1,000.”
tgt: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

src: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
tgt: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.

src: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
tgt: Ase engencho y’omoondoko bwe chinkoro chiraabe n’obwoba, na ase amakumia y’okoirokia, na ase aria morarore n’amaiso aino, nigo morateebe ase engaki ya mambia: ’Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mogoroba, na ase engaki ya mogoroba moteebe: Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mambia.

src: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
tgt: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.

src: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
tgt: Daudi akenyorera erieta rinene ekero arenge koirana, gaitire Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano’isato (18,000) ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.

src: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
tgt: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene bw'Emeganda nabe egutwa y'obonene, na ekiore ki'obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

src: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.
tgt: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene bw'Emeganda nabe egutwa y'obonene, na ekiore ki'obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

src: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
tgt: Ekemincha kiaye kegakurura ensemo ya gatato ye ching'enang'eni chia igoro na gochiyeria ase ense. Na enchoka eria egatenena ase obosio bw'omokuungu oria orenge ang'e koibora, erinde ekero aiboire erie omwana oye.

src: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
tgt: “Koratange okogoro kwao ase rituko ri’Esabato na bwetange tokora amang’ana ao agokogokia ase rituko riane richenu; koraroke Esabato ebe omogooko oo, rituko riria richenu ri’Omonene rituko ri’ogosikwa; korarisike otari kobwatia chinchera chiao omonyene, gose kwerigeria aya agokogokia, na tokwana amang’ana atagwenereti,

src: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons' with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”
tgt: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing'wanso bigosaambwa n'omorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing'wanso bi'ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw'Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki'abamura bao kogenderera botaambe, buna Omonene achiigete.”

src: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
tgt: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero rinene ase Abatomwa ase igo bakaroberia kobaimokeria egetambokero.

src: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn't drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
tgt: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n'Abayuda goika reero iga.

src: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening.
tgt: Moonto onde bwensi oraarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

src: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
tgt: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.

src: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,
tgt: Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw'omoiseke o Farao,

src: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
tgt: Obororo bw'ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw'ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.

src: Look at me and be appalled; put your hand over your mouth.
tgt: Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.

src: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’
tgt: Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire ase more, korende manya aya, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.

src: ‘Hata mavumbi ya mji wenu yaliyoshikamana na miguu yetu, tunayakungʼuta dhidi yenu. Lakini mjue kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’
tgt: Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire ase more, korende manya aya, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.

src: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
tgt: Naki nigo bamiametie amaiso abo tibarora ng’a igoro nao yarenge korwa kare, na ense egatongwa korwa ase amaache, na goetera ase amaache, ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ria Nyasae.

src: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you according to your deeds, since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
tgt: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng’ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

src: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakushughulikia kama unavyostahili, kwa kuwa umedharau kiapo changu kwa kuvunja Agano.
tgt: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng’ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

src: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
tgt: Naki onye ogokora gw’ekiina kwarenge nobonene, igo ogokora kw’oboronge nkore nobonene kobua mono.

src: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
tgt: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.

src: They will fill your houses and the houses of all your officials and every Egyptian—something neither your fathers nor your grandfathers have seen since the day they came into this land.’” Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh’s presence.
tgt: Chinyomba chiaino amo nechi’abasomba bao, na echi’Abamisiri bonsi inachiichorwe ne chingige. Omogwekano bw’echio chisokoro chiao gose chisokoororia chitaroche nonya ng’ake korwa ekero bachaagete komenya ase ense eye goika reero iga.” Erio Musa akaonchoka, akarua o Farao.

src: Nzige hao watajaza nyumba zako, za maafisa wako wote na za Wamisri wote. Jambo ambalo baba zenu wala babu zenu hawajapata kuona tangu siku ile walipoanza kuishi katika nchi hii mpaka leo hii.’ ” Ndipo Mose akageuka na kumwacha Farao.
tgt: Chinyomba chiaino amo nechi’abasomba bao, na echi’Abamisiri bonsi inachiichorwe ne chingige. Omogwekano bw’echio chisokoro chiao gose chisokoororia chitaroche nonya ng’ake korwa ekero bachaagete komenya ase ense eye goika reero iga.” Erio Musa akaonchoka, akarua o Farao.

src: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
tgt: Gaki bono chora abanto ikomi na babere korwa ase ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.

src: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

src: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign. Esther Becomes Queen
tgt: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esiteri akarentwa ase omorwoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti.

src: Esta alipelekwa kwa Mfalme Ahasuero katika makao ya mfalme mwezi wa kumi, yaani mwezi wa Tebethi, katika mwaka wake wa saba wa kutawala.
tgt: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esiteri akarentwa ase omorwoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti.

src: and said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.
tgt: agateebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebiire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oborwoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.

src: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
tgt: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina baite Lazaro boigo,

src: They pursued them a day's journey from Adasa until you come to Gazara, and they sounded an alarm after them with the signal trumpets.
tgt: Abayahudi bakabamonyokia omobaso boira, korwa Adasa goika Gazara na ekero bagendererete kobaminyokia bakaba bakobugia egetuureri gieseegi.

src: Waliwafuata safari ya siku moja kutoka Adasa hadi ulipofika Gazara, nao wakapiga kengele nyuma yao kwa tarumbeta za ishara.
tgt: Abayahudi bakabamonyokia omobaso boira, korwa Adasa goika Gazara na ekero bagendererete kobaminyokia bakaba bakobugia egetuureri gieseegi.

src: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
tgt: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ebiogoita omonto buna oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.

src: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David.
tgt: Abasomba baye bakamobogoria ase egari, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bakamotindeka ase embeera yaye ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi.

src: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
tgt: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

src: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
tgt: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

src: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother's divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
tgt: Aya nar'Omonene akoboria: “Ng'ai riruube ri'ogotigana rire, riria naete nyoko ng'a totigane? Gose monto ki nabwate esira yaye nkabaoonia inwe asare? Taibo! Ebibe nabio biagerete mokaoonigwa, na ogosaria kwaino nakwo kwagerete nyoko agaserigwa.

src: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Iko wapi hati ya talaka ya mama yako ambayo kwayo niliachana naye? Au nimewauza ninyi kwa nani miongoni mwa watu wanaonidai? Kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu mliuzwa, kwa sababu ya makosa, mama yenu aliachwa.
tgt: Aya nar'Omonene akoboria: “Ng'ai riruube ri'ogotigana rire, riria naete nyoko ng'a totigane? Gose monto ki nabwate esira yaye nkabaoonia inwe asare? Taibo! Ebibe nabio biagerete mokaoonigwa, na ogosaria kwaino nakwo kwagerete nyoko agaserigwa.

src: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
tgt: Akamoiraneria: “Ninche ngotomera emaanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Inee! Inki orang'e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”

src: The spirit of man is Yahweh's lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
tgt: Omoika ore ase omonto, n'oro etaya y'Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang'ana onsi are ime y'enkoro y'omonto.

src: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
tgt: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

src: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.
tgt: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

src: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
tgt: Akaagacha naende aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, aria Hezekia ise asaretie. Naende agatenenia ebisasimero bia Baali, na akaroisia omote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, buna Ahabu, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akorete. Agasasiima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching'enang'eni, ebitongwa bia igoro, akabikorera.

src: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
tgt: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng'a abeire bosa ase engencho y'obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

src: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.
tgt: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng'a abeire bosa ase engencho y'obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

src: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
tgt: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching'iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?

src: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
tgt: Korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae nabeire buna inde; na obuya bwaye bore ase 'nde tibwarenge bosa. Korende kobua mono nakorire emeremo goetania bonsi, gose tari inche, korende obuya bwa Nyasae obore amo nainche.

src: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,

src: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
tgt: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

src: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
tgt: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

src: For truly all men who had no perception of God were foolish by nature, and didn't gain power to know him who exists from the good things that are seen. They didn't recognize the architect from his works.
tgt: Abanto bonsi baria batamanyeti Nyasae nigo bare abariri nonya korwa ime. Abanto abwo barorire ebinto ebiya bireo, korende basinyirwe komwancha Nyasae ore moyo. Ere nigo okorigereria ebitongwa biaye korende birobio tibimomanyeti ere oyio ore omoroisia obo.

src: Kwa maana kweli watu wote ambao hawakuwa na ufahamu wa Mungu walikuwa wapumbavu kwa asili, na hawakupata uwezo wa kumjua yeye aliyepo kutokana na mambo mema yanayoonekana. Hawakumtambua mbunifu kutokana na kazi zake.
tgt: Abanto bonsi baria batamanyeti Nyasae nigo bare abariri nonya korwa ime. Abanto abwo barorire ebinto ebiya bireo, korende basinyirwe komwancha Nyasae ore moyo. Ere nigo okorigereria ebitongwa biaye korende birobio tibimomanyeti ere oyio ore omoroisia obo.

src: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
tgt: Agaita na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

src: While they were on the way, a report reached David: “Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king; not one of them is left!”
tgt: Ekaba kobare inchera kogeenda sobo, Daudi agateebigwa ng’a, “Abisalomu oitire abamura bao bonsi, onde tatigareti nonya n’oyomo.”

src: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
tgt: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.

src: Nanyi msimwite mtu yeyote ‘Baba,’ hapa duniani, kwa maana mnaye Baba mmoja, naye yuko mbinguni.
tgt: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.

src: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
tgt: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n'endamwamu.

src: “Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya mbingu ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
tgt: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n'endamwamu.

src: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
tgt: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.

src: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
tgt: Obateebie ng'a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Buna inche inde moyo, naigure amang'ana ayio mwakwanire, ayio naro ndabakorere.

src: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won't be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman's hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
tgt: Debora akamoiraneria, “Goika ''ngende amo naye, korende orogeendo oro tirogokorentera ogotogigwa, ekiagera Omonene nigo agochia gotiga Sisera agwe ase amaboko y'omokuungu.” Erio Debora akaimoka akageenda amo na Baraki, bagaika Kedesi.

src: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,
tgt: Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,

src: He walked in the way of Ahab's house and did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, as did Ahab's house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab's house.
tgt: Ahasia akaba omoko bw'enyomba y'Ahabu, na igo akabwatia chinchera chi'abaanto b'enyomba yaye. Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, buna abanto b'enyomba y'Ahabu bakorete.

src: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
tgt: Tiga endagera ere ase amasio abo, ebe egesugunia ase bare, na oboreba ase abwo bekagete ng'a mbuya bare.

src: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
tgt: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

src: Ndipo mfalme wa Misri akawaita hao wakunga, akawauliza, “Kwa nini mmefanya hivi? Mbona mmeacha watoto wa kiume waishi?”
tgt: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

src: If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
tgt: Onye ndiria nare konyora aase ngotimokera ase erooro, anga nagenda aare, ntige abanto baane, ekiagera bonsi nabatomani, bagosasiima emegwekano; barabwo nomoganda bw’abasigaani.

src: But the man was unwilling to spend the night. He got up and departed, and arrived opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
tgt: Korende omonto oria tancha korara aroro ase obotuko boria. Ase igo akaimoka amo n’omokuungu oye o sere‐sere, bagachaaka orogeendo rwabo gochia Yebusi, (n’oro Yerusalemu), babwate chitigere chiabeekire ebiikaransero.

src: The other Jews who were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder.
tgt: Abayahudi bande abarenge ase chingongo chinde chi'obogambi obwo bagasangerereka amo ase okoegera obogima bwabo, ase okwenyorera obotoereru na gwetooria korwa ase ababisa babo. Bagaita abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na isano (75,000), korende tibakuneti ebinto biabo kobisakora.

src: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
tgt: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.

src: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
tgt: Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogoteera oko, bagoteeba: Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.

src: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
tgt: Erio Yonathani akamoteebia, “Gento kende gionsi oganetie ningokorere.”

src: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
tgt: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi noonchoke obe buna amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.

src: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
tgt: Omotego nomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.

src: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
tgt: Ase ayio nimbe buna ekeegwankwa kegosaria ase Abaefraimu, na buna obogundo ase Abayuda.

src: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
tgt: barabwo bakanyora amang'ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang'e.

src: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah.
tgt: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na kabere bw’okogaamba gwa Peka, mosinto o Remalia, Ahasi mosinto o Yotamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, agachaaka kogamba.

src: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
tgt: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.

src: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
tgt: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agochiteebia: Inche bweka omonyene ninache ekiina ase egati ye ching’ondi chinoru ne chindeu.

src: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
tgt: Naboigo ekero omosacha arabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu na gokagera mok’aye ng’a nomotomani, omosacha oria amorente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omokuani akore onsi aya achiikire.

src: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is executed, and you hang his body on a tree,
tgt: “Onye omonto okorire ebibe na koegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa, asungwe ase omote.

src: May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the LORD delivered you into my hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
tgt: Omonene nigo agoakana kera omonto buna oboronge bwaye bore, na obwegenwa boigo. Ase rituko ria rero Omonene nigo akobeka ase okoboko kwane, korende naanga korambora okoboko kwane igoro ase omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.

src: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
tgt: Ekero amang'ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng'a tinkobugwa.

src: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

tgt: Yoshua amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.

src: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
tgt: Nindue obotenenku bw'omochie oyio, ne chinibo chiaye chionsi, na ebinto bi'amagori amanene bireo ne chikungo chionsi chi'abarwoti b'Abayuda, mbibeeke ase amaboko 'ababisa babo, na abwo babisakore na kobiira Babiloni.

src: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
tgt: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.

src: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
tgt: Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Sumurina riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyore bw’eritang’ani na oyo bw’omoerio, oyo konya okuure, naende akaba moyo.

src: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
tgt: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, na inche nkababooria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”

src: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
tgt: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.

src: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.

src: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
tgt: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).

src: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.

src: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.

src: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

src: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.

src: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

src: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
tgt: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochiika abamura baye amang'ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeeka borere igoro; erio agakwa, erio agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.

src: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
tgt: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.

src: I won't hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,' says the Lord Yahweh.”

src: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.

src: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

tgt: Erio Belisasari akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli abeekerwe eanga emonyinga, ne chisonoi chi’echitaabu igoti riaye, na ararigwe ng’a ere nomogambi o gatato ase obogambi obo.

src: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

tgt: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.

src: Therefore show respect for my words; for it is not good to retain every kind of shame. Not everything is approved by all in good faith.

src: Kwa hivyo heshimu maneno yangu; kwa maana si vizuri kubaki na kila aina ya aibu. Sio kila kitu kinachokubaliwa na wote kwa nia njema.

src: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
tgt: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani, ri'omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Ezra Omokuani akarenta Egetabu ekio ki'Amachiko ase omoganda bwonsi, abasacha na abakungu, nabwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya aya baigwete.

src: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
tgt: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.

src: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
tgt: Ogosaria gwaito kwamentekanire na kwabuchire ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito biatobereire birori. Ogosaria gwaito nigo kore amo naintwe, twamanyire obobe bwaito.

src: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
tgt: Amoni nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ebere agwo Yerusalemu.

src: My son, in your sickness don't be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.

tgt: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

src: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.
tgt: Aye Omonene, koreng'ana ne ring'ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.

src: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,

tgt: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.

src: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
tgt: Ahasi omorwoti akabutora emetobwa y'ebibekerero bi'ebituba, akarusia ebituba korwa aroro, akarusia negetuba keria ekenene giaterekereretwe igoro ase emegwekano ye chiombe yaroisirie korwa ase etai akageterekerera inse aase atichire namagena.

src: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.

src: those who had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and those who hoarded up silver and gold, in which people trust, and of their getting there is no end?
tgt: Ng'ai bare baria baroberetie na gwechanda korigia enibo abwo emeremo yabo etatigete kemanyererio kende?

src: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
tgt: Bono abanto baane barwarete oborwaire bwa ukoma mbaarenge agwo ase egesoero ki'egeita. Barabwo bagateebania: “Ninki gekogera toikaranse aiga goika tokwe?

src: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
tgt: Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyomenyete ase egati yao, nigo are omorwani etuoni okogotooria. Ere nigo akogokerete nomogooko omonene. Nabe okirete‐kiri ore nobwanchani bwaye; akogokere nogoteera kw'omogooko.

src: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
tgt: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.

src: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.
tgt: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

src: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

src: Neno: Neno la Bwana liko kinyume na nchi ya Hadraki na Dameski itakuwa mahali pa kupumzika, kwa kuwa macho ya watu na ya kabila zote za Israeli yako kwa Bwana,
tgt: Eri nering'ana rikong'u riakwanetwe n'Omonene igoro y'ense ya Hadaraki, riikere nonya nomochie o Damesiki. Amaiso 'abaanto b'ebisaku amo nay'Abaisraeli nigo arigereretie Omonene.

src: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”

src: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
tgt: Abanto babere kobararaare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?

src: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
tgt: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.

src: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
tgt: Manoa agateebia mokaaye, “Amaene goika tokwe, ekiagera twarorire Nyasae.”

src: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
tgt: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng'a inatobe moyo amo nere.

src: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before Yahweh's house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before Yahweh was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.
tgt: Ase rituko riria omorwoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw'eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw'enyomba y'Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na ebitinya bi'ebing'wanso bi'omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi'etai ekiarenge ase obosio bw'Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na ebitinya bi'ebing'wanso bi'omorembe.

src: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
tgt: Genda mweorokererie engencho yaye ninki: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng'wanso. Inaki tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyabibe.”

src: Nendeni mkajifunze maana ya maneno haya: ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu.' Kwa maana sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”

src: The king said to his servants, “Don't you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?
tgt: Erio omorwoti agateebia abasomba baye, “Timomanyeti ng'a reero omonto omonene, omogambi bw'Abaisraeli, okuure?

src: But I replied, “Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!”
tgt: Korende nkamoteebia, “Inee! Omonto onga buna inche ningwenerete gotama? Omonto onga buna inche ninyare gotama gochia ase Hekalu ime, ase ogotooria obogima bwane? Tinkonyara kogenda aroro.”

src: For many are called, but few are chosen.” Paying Taxes to Caesar (Mark 12:13–17; Luke 20:19–26)
tgt: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.” Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mar 12:13-17; Luk 20:20-26)

src: “Kwa maana walioitwa ni wengi, lakini walioteuliwa ni wachache.” Kulipa Kodi Kwa Kaisari (Marko 12:13-17; Luka 20:20-26)
tgt: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.” Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mar 12:13-17; Luk 20:20-26)

src: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.

src: So when this agreement had been made, Lysias departed to the king, and the Jews went about their farming.
tgt: Ekero okobwatana kw'omorembe gati y'Abayahudi na Abasiria kwaerete, Lisia akairana ase omorwoti n'Abayahudi bakairana gochia ase emeremo yabo ya mogondo.

src: Kwa hiyo, baada ya makubaliano haya kufanywa, Lisia akaenda kwa mfalme, na Wayahudi wakaanza kazi zao za kilimo.
tgt: Ekero okobwatana kw'omorembe gati y'Abayahudi na Abasiria kwaerete, Lisia akairana ase omorwoti n'Abayahudi bakairana gochia ase emeremo yabo ya mogondo.

src: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
tgt: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

src: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?
tgt: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

src: The Levite replied, “We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote hill country of Ephraim, where I am from. I went to Bethlehem in Judah, and now I am going to the house of the LORD; but no one has taken me into his home,
tgt: Omogendi oria akamoiraneria, “Igo tokorwa Bethlehemu o Yuda, tokogeenda rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, nao seito. Igo nageenda Bethlehemu o Yuda, na bono nkogeenda inde ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Onde tari bwanchire gonsoyia nyomba mwaye.

src: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
tgt: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakariikera aborokigwa b'aroro riruube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,

src: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
tgt: Naende bakarema, bakanyora entuboka ende, nero bakayiomanera. Ase igo, akayeroka Sitina.

src: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh's name;' and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.
tgt: Nigo erabe ng'a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng'ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamoteebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri'Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.

src: Ikiwa yupo yeyote atakayeendelea kutabiri, baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamwambia, ‘Ni lazima ufe, kwa sababu umesema uongo kwa jina la Bwana.' Atakapotabiri, wazazi wake mwenyewe watampasua tumbo.
tgt: Nigo erabe ng'a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng'ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamoteebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri'Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.

src: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
tgt: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oria ogeikaranserete.

src: or in like manner, the six hundred thousand footmen who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.

src: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
tgt: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri ase obong'aini bwaye, na kera omoturi nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano y'ogosasimwa aroisirie, ekiagera emegwekano yaye ney'obong'ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yabo.

src: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
tgt: Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y'omogwekano bw'emori bagosasiima agwo Beti‐Aveni. Abwo bakoyosasiima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng'ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.

src: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
tgt: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abaanto oriikwe ase ense yonsi.

src: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
tgt: Erio Pilato akamoteebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteeba igoro yao?”

src: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
tgt: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo.

src: Nao wale Mungu aliotangulia kuwachagua, akawaita, wale aliowaita pia akawahesabia haki, nao wale aliowahesabia haki, pia akawatukuza.
tgt: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo.

src: Then the young man said to the angel, “Brother Azarias, I have heard that this maid has been given to seven men, and that they all perished in the bride-chamber.
tgt: Tobia agateebia Rafaeli, “Inche naigure ayio abanyorete abasacha batano na babere abwo barigetie komonywoma Sara na buna kera oyomo akwete mobasokano ase rituko ri'enywuomo; kera oyomo nigo akwete magega batarara nere.

src: Kisha kijana akamwambia malaika, “Ndugu Azaria, nimesikia kwamba mjakazi huyu amepewa wanaume saba, na kwamba wote waliangamia katika chumba cha bibi harusi.”
tgt: Tobia agateebia Rafaeli, “Inche naigure ayio abanyorete abasacha batano na babere abwo barigetie komonywoma Sara na buna kera oyomo akwete mobasokano ase rituko ri'enywuomo; kera oyomo nigo akwete magega batarara nere.

src: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
tgt: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang'ani tore b'okobarentera inwe enchiri ya Kristo.

src: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air, no evidence of its passage is found, but the light wind, lashed with the stroke of its pinions, and torn apart with the violent rush of the moving wings, is passed through. Afterwards no sign of its coming remains.
tgt: Gose buna enyoni ekoiruruka ase embeo etari gotiga kemanyererio kende gionsi ase egoetera; ero nigo egoaka aka embeo inke inke ase chimbaba chiaye, ero nigo egoeta ase embeo korende teri gotiga kemanyererio ase yaetire.

src: Au ni kama ndege anaporuka angani, hakuna ushahidi wa kupita kwake unaopatikana, lakini upepo mwepesi, unaopigwa kwa mapigo ya mabawa yake, na kupasuka kwa mshindo mkali wa mabawa yanayotembea, hupitishwa. Baadaye hakuna dalili ya kuja kwake iliyobaki.
tgt: Gose buna enyoni ekoiruruka ase embeo etari gotiga kemanyererio kende gionsi ase egoetera; ero nigo egoaka aka embeo inke inke ase chimbaba chiaye, ero nigo egoeta ase embeo korende teri gotiga kemanyererio ase yaetire.

src: The whole assembly who had returned from exile made booths and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this. And there was great rejoicing.
tgt: Omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakaagacha ebigutu bamenye imeo, ekiagera korwa ase engaki ya Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, goika ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli konya tibana gokora bo. Na bono bakaba nomogooko omonene.

src: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
tgt: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.

src: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
tgt: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachiigete.

src: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
tgt: Kristo nomogwekano o Nyasae oyotari kororekana, omoiborwa bw'eritang'ani bw'ebitongwa bionsi.

src: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
tgt: Bagakora egesibao ki'obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi'etaabu, na echi'amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi'egatani engiya chisisire.

src: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”

src: Nilishangilia pamoja na wale walioniambia, “Twende nyumbani ya Bwana.”

src: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
tgt: Naboigo ase amanag’ana y’enchiri babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochoorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.

src: and his wife was given to one of the men who had accompanied him.
tgt: Erio moga Samusoni akaegwa omonto oria orenge omong’wansi o Samusoni, akaba mokaaye.

src: Year after year Elkanah would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh, where Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to the LORD.

src: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

src: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

src: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

src: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
tgt: Samweli agakwa, na Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bakagenda komoreera; bakamotindeka ase enka yaye agwo Rama. Erio Daudi akaimoka, agatirimboka gochia ase erooro ya Parani.

src: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli bakoorire goita abanto bonsi ba Ai abarenge agwo aase aarabu, na ase erooro, ase baabaseretie gochia, bakairana Ai, bagaita nemioro bonsi abarenge aroro.

src: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.

src: Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
tgt: Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.

src: All the tribes which fell away together sacrificed to the heifer Baal, and so did the house of Naphtali my father.

tgt: Aye Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!

src: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

tgt: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

src: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?

src: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
tgt: Oko nokomaanoka kwa Yeso Kristo oko Nyasae amoete, erinde arokie abasomba baye amang’ana agwenerete gocha gokoreka bwango. Ase ogotoma omomalaika oye akoorokia omosomba oye Yohana,

src: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
tgt: Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogooko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abaanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?

src: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
tgt: Esau akabooria ise: “Ogosesenia nokomo gwoka kwabwate, Tata? Nsesenia nainche boigo, Tata ominto.” Esau agaaka egakuura, na akarera nobororo.

src: Though his hatred is concealed by deception, his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
tgt: Naisa gotuba okogecha kwaye nobong’ainereria, obokayayu bwaye goika bomanyekane n’omosangererekano bwonsi.

src: “Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
tgt: “Irana oteebie Hezekia, omoraai bw’abaanto baane, ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi, sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteeba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, ninkogwenie. Rituko ria gatato notiire ogende ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene.

src: And now God sent me to heal you and Sarah your daughter-in-law.
tgt: Boigo nere ontomete 'nchiche gokogwenia boigo na gokonya moka momura oo Sara.

src: Na sasa Mungu alinituma nikuponye wewe na Sara mkwe wako.
tgt: Boigo nere ontomete 'nchiche gokogwenia boigo na gokonya moka momura oo Sara.

src: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.
tgt: Ninyonsie ense nemegoko y'amanyinga ao, aichore aike ase ebitunwa igoro, ne chindooche chiichorwe naro.

src: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

src: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

src: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

src: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
tgt: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.

src: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him; for God's temple is holy, which you are.
tgt: Onye omonto ogosaria Hekalu ya Nyasae, Nyasae nasarie omonto oyio; naki Hekalu ya Nyasae nenchenu, nero ninwe.

src: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other's flesh.”

src: At that time I also said to the people, “Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they can stand guard by night and work by day.”
tgt: Boigo ngateebia abanto ng’a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y’okoagacha.

src: Wakati huo pia niliwaambia watu, “Kila mtu na msaidizi wake wakae ndani ya Yerusalemu wakati wa usiku, ili waweze kutumika kama walinzi wakati wa usiku, na kufanya kazi wakati wa mchana.”
tgt: Boigo ngateebia abanto ng’a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y’okoagacha.

src: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

src: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn't pay attention to any of his ways,

src: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

src: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,

src: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn't make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?
tgt: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang'ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng'anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemoteebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?

src: Take heed lest you slip with it, lest you fall before one who lies in wait.

src: Since we are now about to celebrate the purification of the temple in the month Chislev, on the twenty-fifth day, we thought it necessary to notify you, so that you may also keep a feast of tabernacles, and remember the fire which was given when Nehemiah offered sacrifices, after he had built both the temple and the altar.
tgt: Ase rituko ri'emerongo ebere n'atano ase omotienyi o Kisilevu nigo togocha gochengera rituko rinene r'ogochenwa gwe Hekalu, buna togochengera rituko rinene ri'echiema. tgt: Korende barabwo bagateebania, Bono tiga toagaache oboyia egesaku giaito! Torwane toegerere abanto baito na egesasiimero giaito.

src: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can't come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.'”
tgt: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

src: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Watu hawawezi kupanda mlima Sinai kwa sababu wewe mwenyewe ulituonya ukisema, ‘Wekeni mipaka kuuzunguka mlima na kuutenga kama patakatifu.' ”
tgt: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

src: He did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
tgt: Ere agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene, buna aya onsi Usia ise akorete.

src: Akafanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana, kama Uzia baba yake alivyokuwa amefanya.
tgt: Ere agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene, buna aya onsi Usia ise akorete.

src: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
tgt: Ninde nokoganyererera okonene n'ogosemeria ng'a tingosookigwa ase enchera ende yonsi, korende ase oboremu bwane bwonsi, bono buna botambe, Kristo naegwe ogosika ase omobere one, keraabe ase obogima gose ase ogokwa.

src: I was nursed with care in swaddling clothes.
tgt: Inkaboigwa chianga chi'abana, 'nkarendwa ase enchera engiya.

src: Nililelewa kwa uangalifu nikiwa nimevaa nguo za kitoto.
tgt: Inkaboigwa chianga chi'abana, 'nkarendwa ase enchera engiya.

src: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.
tgt: Igwa eriogi ri'abaanto bagotama korwa ase ense ya Babiloni, bakoraria ase Sayoni igoro y'Omonene, Nyasae oito, buna akoruseria Hekalu yaye egesiomba.

src: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn't listen.
tgt: Omonene agakwana na Manase na abanto bonsi, korende bakaanga koigwera.

src: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of these tithes to the storerooms of the treasury in the house of our God.
tgt: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

src: Kuhani atokanaye na uzao wa Aroni atashirikiana na Walawi wakati wanapopokea zaka, nao Walawi itawapasa kuleta sehemu ya kumi ya zaka katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu katika ghala za hazina.
tgt: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

src: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
tgt: oyoruetwe ase ogokwa ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na akabokigwa ekiagera otorenteire oboronge.

src: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
tgt: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokuungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakuure.

src: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
tgt: “Irania omoyio ase ekeraaro kiaye! Agwo ase ense mwatongeretwe, ense y'obobiare bwaino, nao 'ndabanachere ekiina.

src: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
tgt: Barabwo kobarakoborie ng’a ng’ai bakogenda, obateebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto baria bagochia gokwa ase oborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo, na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero; baria bagochia gokwa ase enchara, bakwe nenchara, na baria bagochia gwoswa, booswe bairwe.

src: Nao kama wakikuuliza, ‘Twende wapi?’ Waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “ ‘Wale waliowekwa kwa ajili ya kufa, wakafe; waliowekwa kwa ajili ya upanga, kwa upanga; waliowekwa kwa ajili ya njaa, kwa njaa: waliowekwa kwa ajili ya kutekwa, watekwe.’ ”
tgt: Barabwo kobarakoborie ng’a ng’ai bakogenda, obateebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto baria bagochia gokwa ase oborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo, na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero; baria bagochia gokwa ase enchara, bakwe nenchara, na baria bagochia gwoswa, booswe bairwe.

src: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
tgt: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw'oborimo nigo agokwana obong'ainereria.

src: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, as Manasseh his father did.
tgt: Amoni agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, buna ise akorete.

src: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
tgt: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

src: Jambo hili likaendelea kwa muda wa miaka miwili, kiasi kwamba Wayahudi na Wayunani wote walioishi huko Asia wakawa wamesikia neno la Bwana. Wana Wa Skewa Wajaribu Kutoa Pepo Mchafu
tgt: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

src: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tgt: Naki amang’ana aya karabe ime yaino na komenteka, nabakore timoba aboro gose abanto motari nokwama, ase okomomanya Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

src: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
tgt: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

src: God's anger burned because he went; and Yahweh's angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
tgt: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.

src: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
tgt: Akanachana chinyama chi'emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi'enda na ebirenge namaache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, n'ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi'emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

src: Mose akamkata yule kondoo dume vipande vipande na kukiteketeza kichwa, vile vipande na yale mafuta.
tgt: Akanachana chinyama chi'emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi'enda na ebirenge namaache. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

src: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
tgt: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

src: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
tgt: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

src: Kulikuwa na vita vinavyoendelea kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
tgt: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

src: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
tgt: Ase ayio ekero abanto b'ebisaku bionsi na ab'emenwa yonsi baigwete eriogi ri'ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amariogi a kera egento ki'amatera, bonsi bakaba bagatung'ama na gosasiima omogwekano bw'etaabu, oria omorwoti konya atenenetie.

src: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.
tgt: Naende Isumaeli agaita Abayahudi bonsi barenge amo na Gedalia agwo Misipa, agaita nabasikari b'Abakalidayo abwo banyorekanete bare aase agwo.

src: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
tgt: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

src: Ndiyo sababu mpaka leo makuhani wa Dagoni wala wengine waingiao katika hekalu la Dagoni huko Ashdodi hawakanyagi kizingiti.
tgt: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

src: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
tgt: Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora egetabu eringanirie ekoiruruka.

src: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
tgt: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.

src: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
tgt: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

src: Huyu ndiye “ ‘jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilikataa, ambalo limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.’
tgt: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

src: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
tgt: Ase ayio Omokuani akaa Daudi emegati eria emechenu, ekiagera mogati onde torengeo otatiga eria konya yarusigwe korwa ase obosio bw'Omonene, erinde eyere iberera ebekweo ase rituko erio.

src: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests. The Death of Joash (2 Chronicles 24:23–27)
tgt: Chibesa chiarenge koruegwa ase okorongeyia okomocha, na echio chiarenge koruegwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe tichiarentetwe ase enyomba y’Omonene; echio nigo chiabeete echi’abakuani.

src: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”
tgt: Moinyore Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang'e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogooko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”

src: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
tgt: Amasia agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi agwo ase Riranya ri'enyancha y'omonyoo; akaira omochie o Sela ase okorwana esegi, akayoroka Yokiteli; naboigo okorokwa goika reero iga.

src: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
tgt: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.

src: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
tgt: Amaote a Samaria takonyara kobwenigwa nabo igo Yuda yabereiri ange gochandeka enchera eyio eyio; ogotagorwa gwaikire ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu enyene agwo ase abanto bane bamenyete.”

src: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
tgt: Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.

src: Usisumbuke kwa ajili ya watendao maovu, wala usiwaonee wivu watendao mabaya,
tgt: Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.

src: He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
tgt: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.

src: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.
tgt: Ase ayio, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, tiga ring'ana riao riria gwatebeetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.

src: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”
tgt: Onye Abaisraeli bagochia korenda na gokora onsi aya nabachigete, na babwate amachiiko onsi na emeroberio yonsi echiikire goetera ase Musa, rirorio tingotiga Abaisraeli barue ase ense eye naete chisokoro chiabo.”

src: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
tgt: ekero ki'obokuani obonene bw'Anasi na Kayafa, ring'ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.

src: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding in every kind of literature and wisdom. And Daniel had insight into all kinds of visions and dreams.
tgt: Nyasae akaa abamura baria baane chiseemi na obomanyi bw’okomanya amariiko ao ao, na obong’aini bwonsi; naende akaa Danieli obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho y’amaroro ne chindoto.

src: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.
tgt: Abaisraeli bagachia korora ng'a bamigirwe nobokong'u, bagatang'ang'a na kwebisa ase amabwago, na ase chinsana na ebitare ime, nonya nase chingoro na ase amakuruma.

src: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
tgt: Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng'a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y'ense yonsi.

src: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

src: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
tgt: Inee! Aye nonyare kong'usa Leviatani, eng'iti enene y'okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?

tgt: Inee! Aye nonyare kong'usa Leviatani, eng'iti enene y'okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?

src: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
tgt: Inaki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwa kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.

src: Hezron was the father of Ram, Ram was the father of Amminadab,
tgt: Hezironi akaibora Ramu, na Ramu akaibora Aminadabu;

src: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king's gate.
tgt: Hataki akagenda ase Moredekai agwo ase eraaro y'omochie, bosio bw'egeita ki'enyomba y'omorwoti.

src: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
tgt: Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibetie. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)

src: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then Yahweh said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
tgt: Omonene akamboria, “Amos, ngento ki eke orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto bane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng'ake.”

src: Akaniuliza, “Amosi, unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Kikapu chenye matunda yaliyoiva.” Ndipo Bwana akaniambia, “Wakati umewadia kwa watu wangu Israeli; sitawahurumia zaidi.”
tgt: Omonene akamboria, “Amos, ngento ki eke orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto bane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng'ake.”

src: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
tgt: Na barabwo abanchete ring'ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng'ana chilifu isato.

src: Wale wote waliopokea ujumbe wa Petro kwa furaha wakabatizwa na siku ile waliongezeka watu wapatao 3,000.

src: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
tgt: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.”

src: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Bwana, tazama hapa kuna panga mbili.” Akawajibu, “Inatosha.”
tgt: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.”

src: until there arose a different king who didn't know Joseph.

tgt: Na Esau agasaba Yakobo: “Koranche, ong'e omosori oyio omobariri inywe, ekiagera n akuure enchara.” Ase ayio bakamoroka Edomu (engencho yaye, omobariri).

src: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon. Rehoboam’s Family

tgt: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti biababisa bao; abamura ba iso ng’a batugame bosio bwao na amasikani.

src: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
tgt: Naki aye ore omoseera naende oyo bw'okogokia mono! Aye omwanchi bw'okogokia!

src: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
tgt: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu.

src: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
tgt: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

src: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
tgt: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

src: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man's wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
tgt: Teebia Abaisraeli: Ebaise koba ng'a omokungu bw'omonto obeire otari omwegenwa' ase are.

src: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn't yet come, the time for Yahweh's house to be built.'”
tgt: Aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng'a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y'Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”
